title: Rewrite TF tenant-binding and add GPU subnet sweeper for private installs
author: Leah Patel
description: Motivation: private installs with multi-tenant GPU pools had recurring issues during upgrades where leftover subnet attachments and stale IAM role bindings prevented smooth nodepool replacements. This PR rewrites the tenant-binding Terraform module to be idempotent across state transitions, extracts a lightweight gpu_subnet_sweeper module to clean dangling subnet attachments, improves state layout annotations to reduce cross-resource drift, and adds a migration tool and guidance for customers. Changes are split into refactors (module boundaries), small behavioural changes (sweeper idempotency and retry windows), and non-breaking migration scripts. Checklist: - [x] New tenant-binding module with clearer inputs/outputs - [x] gpu_subnet_sweeper module with safe dry-run mode - [x] Migration script that migrates tfstate references and runs sweeper in dry-run by default - [x] Unit tests for new modules and integration plan - [x] Docs update and upgrade notes. Related: ENG-4421, PM-88. See design doc: internal/link?doc=private-tf-tenant-binding-2026 for details.
commits: refactor(terraform): split tenant binding into modules/tenant-binding
feat(terraform): add modules/gpu_subnet_sweeper with dry-run and reconcile mode
test(terraform): add unit tests for tenant-binding and sweeper
docs: add upgrade notes and example migration runbook
review_comments: Marco: Looks good overall, please ensure the sweeper has a conservative default and clear opt-in for destructive operations.
Leah (author): Sweeper defaults to dry-run and requires confirm=true for destructive mode; documented in README.
Anika: Migration script should be idempotent and log changes in a machine-readable format.
Leah (author): Migration now writes a JSON audit log and includes --noop flag; updated tests to cover rollbacks.
Bryan: Please add a short runbook for SRE on rollback and post-migration checks.
Leah (author): Added docs/private-upgrades/tenant-binding-migration.md with runbook and sample commands.
release_notes: Idempotent tenant-binding Terraform module; new gpu_subnet_sweeper module (dry-run default); tfstate migration script and operator runbook for private installs. Non-breaking but recommended for clusters experiencing nodepool replacement failures.
upgrade_instructions: Summary: 1) Run scripts/tfstate-migrate-tenantrefs.sh --noop to preview state changes 2) Review audit log at /var/tmp/tf-migration.json 3) Apply tenant-binding module in a canary workspace 4) Run sweeper with --noop then with --confirm on canary 5) Roll forward to remaining workspaces once canary is healthy. Full steps in docs/private-upgrades/tenant-binding-migration.md
notes_for_ops: Sweeper operation will not detach subnets by default. To remove dangling attachments set --confirm and ensure nodepool autoscaling is paused. Monitor cloud provider network logs for permission failures. IAM role changes are additive; existing roles are preserved unless --prune is used.
security_considerations: Added least-privilege IAM role for the migration script with explicit logging and a short-lived service account. Security scan passed but recommend rotating any service account keys used during one-off runs.
testrun_summary: Unit tests: tenant-binding coverage + integration plan against a small emulated tfstate passed. Manual dry-run migration on a staging vf cluster produced zero destructive actions. CI flakiness fixed by increasing AWS API retry window in sweeper.
